WORDS: Mary A. Lathbury, 1877; v. 3-4 Alexander Groves, pub.1913. MUSIC: “Bread of Life”; William F. Sherwin, 1877. Public Domain.
Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst. Jn. 6:35
